# R6 draft oracle

The ten new `corpus-path-*-v1` packages preserve the existing twenty-character
R5 teaching, sources and pending audio exactly, changing only package and renderer
identity. The expected target pairs come from the existing independent R5 oracle.
Word/reading/context literals are frozen copies of the authored pending material,
not an independent Mandarin review. Future edits must update the exact package
and reviewed oracle versions; no runtime grader lookup derives expected answers.

This profile supplies engineering drafts only. All actual language, audio, device
and owner gates remain pending. In an isolated verification installation its
source classification is forced fixture; it cannot create real reviewed coverage.
